newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions 6-month bonds worth 8bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions 6-month bonds worth 8bln rupees.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned on Monday six-month maturity short-term federal bonds worth a total of 8.097 billion rupees at a weighted average yield of 16.9663 percent per annum.
The auction will be settled on Wednesday, the bank said.
The bank had set a pre-auction target of 8.0 billion rupees and received bids worth a total of 10.247 billion rupees, out of which bids for 8.097 billion rupees were accepted.
In the previous auction held on February 4, bids worth 4.070 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 16.9403 percent per annum.
